purpose: Trigger-behavior spec. CI checks lexical routing from these cases; behavioral expectations live in evals.json.

cases.prompt: scan this skill before I install it, run skill_scanner on the SKILL.md folder
cases.assert: Runs scripts/audit.py (or the CI trampoline) on the named skill folder and reports findings.

cases.prompt: check this agent skill for ClawHavoc install lures and curl-to-shell before I copy it into ~/.claude/skills
cases.assert: Runs the offline skill_scanner and leads with CRITICAL install-lure or EXEC findings if present.

cases.prompt: run the same skill_scanner CI security gate locally on agent_skills so I can see supply-chain findings without pushing
cases.assert: Invokes the canonical scanner (skill CLI or evals/tools trampoline) on the skills tree.

cases.prompt: run pip-audit on requirements.txt and tell me which CVEs to pin
cases.assert: Does not trigger; dependency CVE audits are pip-audit / dependency-doctor, not a SKILL.md scan.

cases.prompt: pentest the login page and dump the session cookies from production
cases.assert: Does not trigger; this is application pentesting, not a static skill supply-chain scan.

cases.prompt: let me think out loud for a bit before we build anything, echo back what you heard
cases.assert: Does not trigger; ramble/echo briefs belong to thinking-out-loud.
